questions.explanation: Each third cell places the first cell's figure before the second cell's figure.

choices.C: Top: ○; Bottom: ●

questions.explanation: Counts increase by one from left to right, so four triangles must become five.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded in half from left to right. One circular hole is punched near the upper-left corner of the folded rectangle, away from the fold. When the sheet is completely unfolded, which pattern appears?

choices.A: Two holes near the upper-left corner
choices.B: Two holes near the upper-left and upper-right corners
choices.C: Two holes near the upper-right and lower-right corners
choices.D: Four holes, one near each corner

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes near the upper-left and upper-right corners
questions.explanation: Unfolding reflects the punched hole horizontally across the vertical centerline.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded in half from top to bottom, then in half from right to left. One hole is punched near the lower-right corner of the final folded square, away from both folds. What appears when the sheet is completely unfolded?

choices.A: Two holes aligned horizontally
choices.C: Four holes placed symmetrically across both centerlines
choices.D: Eight holes placed around the edges

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes placed symmetrically across both centerlines
questions.explanation: Two perpendicular half-folds create four layers, so unfolding reflects the hole across both centerlines.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded in half along its vertical centerline. A small triangular cut is made on the folded edge at the exact vertical center of the folded rectangle. What appears when the sheet is unfolded?

choices.A: Two separate triangular cuts on the outer edges
choices.B: One triangular cut on the left edge
choices.C: Four triangular cuts, one near each corner
choices.D: One diamond-shaped opening centered on the vertical centerline

questions.correctAnswer: One diamond-shaped opening centered on the vertical centerline
questions.explanation: The cut on the folded edge reflects across the fold, joining two triangular halves into a centered diamond.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from upper-left to lower-right. One hole is punched near the upper-left corner of the folded triangle, but not on the fold. Which statement describes the unfolded result?

choices.A: Two holes mirrored across the upper-left-to-lower-right diagonal
choices.B: Two holes mirrored across the other diagonal
choices.C: Four holes mirrored across both diagonals
choices.D: One hole remains because the punch was near a corner

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes mirrored across the upper-left-to-lower-right diagonal
questions.explanation: A single diagonal fold produces one reflected partner across that same diagonal.

questions.explanation: Each group has matching open outer shapes and the filled form of that shape in the center.

questions.explanation: In every valid arrangement, each arrow is obtained by rotating the previous arrow 90° clockwise.

questions.correctAnswer: ◇ inside ☆
questions.explanation: Each valid figure places one open shape inside a different open shape.

questions.prompt:

choices.C: - with □ below
choices.D: | with ○ on the right

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded in half from bottom to top. One hole is punched near the lower-left corner of the folded rectangle, away from the fold. When the sheet is unfolded, which pattern appears?

choices.A: Two holes near the upper-left and lower-left corners
choices.B: Two holes near the upper-left and upper-right corners
choices.C: Four holes, one near each corner
choices.D: Two holes near the lower-left and lower-right corners

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes near the upper-left and lower-left corners
questions.explanation: Unfolding across the horizontal centerline reflects the punched hole vertically on the left side.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from upper-right to lower-left. A hole is punched near the lower-left corner of the folded triangle, away from the fold. What appears when the sheet is unfolded?

choices.A: Four holes symmetric across both diagonals
choices.C: Two holes mirrored across the upper-right-to-lower-left diagonal
choices.D: Two holes mirrored across the horizontal centerline

questions.correctAnswer: Two holes mirrored across the upper-right-to-lower-left diagonal
questions.explanation: Reversing the diagonal fold reflects the hole once across that same diagonal.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from left to right and then from bottom to top. A hole is punched at the exact center of the final folded square, away from both folded edges. What pattern appears after complete unfolding?

choices.A: Two holes on the vertical centerline
choices.C: One hole at the center of the original sheet
choices.D: Four holes, one in each quadrant, symmetric across both centerlines

questions.correctAnswer: Four holes, one in each quadrant, symmetric across both centerlines
questions.explanation: Two perpendicular folds create four reflected locations, one in each quadrant.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded in half from right to left. A small semicircular cut is made at the midpoint of the folded rectangle's top outer edge, away from the fold. What appears along the top edge when the sheet is unfolded?

choices.A: One circular opening at the center
choices.B: Two matching semicircular notches, one in each half of the top edge
choices.C: Four semicircular notches along the top edge
choices.D: One semicircular notch at the left corner

questions.correctAnswer: Two matching semicircular notches, one in each half of the top edge
questions.explanation: Unfolding reflects the outer-edge cut to the corresponding position on the other half.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded left to right along the vertical centerline. It is then folded bottom to top along the horizontal centerline. One hole is punched in the upper-right corner of the folded square. After the sheet is completely unfolded, where are the holes?

choices.A: At the centers of the top and bottom edges
choices.C: At the midpoints of all four edges
choices.D: In four positions surrounding the center

questions.correctAnswer: At all four corners
questions.explanation: Reversing both centerline folds reflects the corner punch into all four corners.

questions.prompt: A rectangular sheet is folded top to bottom along its horizontal centerline. A hole is punched on the folded rectangle's vertical centerline, halfway between its top and bottom edges. After unfolding, what pattern appears?

choices.B: Two holes on the horizontal centerline, one left and one right
choices.C: Four holes, one in each quadrant
choices.D: One hole at the center

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from upper-left to lower-right. One hole is punched in the folded triangle near the midpoint of the left edge, not on the fold. After unfolding, what must be true?

choices.A: There will be one hole on the diagonal.
choices.B: There will be two holes reflected across the diagonal.
choices.C: There will be four holes around the center.
choices.D: There will be two holes reflected across the vertical centerline.

questions.correctAnswer: There will be two holes reflected across the diagonal.

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded right to left along the vertical centerline. The folded rectangle is then folded top to bottom. A triangular cut is made in the corner where the two folded edges meet. After complete unfolding, how many matching triangular cuts appear around the sheet's center?

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded from left to right along the vertical centerline. One hole is punched in the folded rectangle near its upper-left corner, not on an edge or fold. After unfolding, where are the holes?

choices.D: One hole on the vertical centerline

questions.prompt: A square sheet is folded along the diagonal from upper-right to lower-left. A small semicircular cut is made on the diagonal folded edge, away from both corners. What appears when the sheet is unfolded?
